rationale.hitl-workflow: Human-command envelopes provide bounded delegation, approval gates, and fail-safe authority.
rationale.oversight-theater: High-volume reviewers lack time, evidence, and authority beyond rubber-stamping.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Transaction volume makes meaningful per-item verification structurally infeasible.
rationale.rules-based-checks: External policy engines and circuit breakers deterministically enforce constraints.
rationale.risk-routing: Risk tiers and envelope failures determine automation versus human escalation.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Intent, provenance, constraints, and previews support informed human judgment.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Operating envelopes bound agent actions beyond authorized intent and scope.
rationale.org-governance: Defines policy ownership, accountability, audit logging, procurement, and adoption controls.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Translates EU AI Act and NIST oversight duties into evidence requirements.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Immutable receipts persist inputs, policies, payloads, identities, and versions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes transaction-level HITL as performative liability transfer.
rationale.framework: MV-HIC is a reusable control-plane governance architecture.
rationale.design-only: Detailed architecture and artifacts are proposed; implementation remains future work.
rationale.general-ai: Framework governs consequential AI actions across regulated sectors, not coding specifically.
rationale.agentic: Targets delegated systems that plan, invoke tools, and execute consequential actions.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes rubber-stamping, confidence badges, and erosion of human competence.
